text_zh: 左边第三个架子，东西比较新

text_en: Don't touch the glowing ones - burns

text_zh: 铅币不够就问管事的要表单
text_en: Low on coins? Ask for forms

text_zh: 又涨价了…上周还是三个铅币
text_en: Prices up again... was 3 coins last week

text_zh: 谁把铅笔拿走了？我写到一半！
text_en: Who took my pencil?? Was writing!

text_zh: 这破地方连个椅子都没有
text_en: Not even a chair in this place

text_zh: D-0347说这个好使，试过确实不错
text_en: D-0347 says this works - tried it, good
From D-0288: don't touch corner pile

text_zh: 昨天又有人没回来，编号被擦掉了
text_en: Someone didn't return yesterday, number erased

text_zh: 这里的东西晚上会自己移动位置
text_en: Things move by themselves at night here
